Correction: independent cryptographic 128-bit salt stored with the request; new seed The algorithm, the walking parameters and the sample sizes did not change after watching the pilot.

Negative controls in the pilot were mistakenly not executed prior to measurements CONTROLS.json The protocol of the original version is saved with the pilot, the unfinished processes are stopped, and these fixes concern isolation and the order of the checks, not setting the algorithm according to the results.

2026-10-30, Clean launch complete: 168/168 decisions; 26 The public interface has been corrected, the code for the walks themselves is matched by the pilot N=2^18: search 6209.06 compounding 34085.62 full-range tame, meanness 5.4897. Memory of both walks is small; table sqrt(KN) Detailed limits on the actual width and the truth of the model ALGORITHM.md and CONCLUSION.md. This is a new result relative to E1g: It shows a specific memory diagram, not just eight independent diagrams interval-DLP.

The whole brute force here is synthetic155 not transmitted solver; It is further limited by a general range of no more than 2^28. No keys/bits Puzzle The next step is to independently test the probability of success and the constants of the method on large synthetic tasks, preserving the separation of the algorithm and the generator hypothesis.
